assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: game-ready pixel art chicken sprite sheet for the cozy 2D map in Bitácora Amorcito.
Input images: image 1 is the ONLY identity reference, the fluffy grey chicken in the photo. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for the game's warm pixel-art style; do not reproduce the scenery, UI or people.
Primary request: one complete animation sheet of THIS distinctive fluffy grey chicken. Faithfully simplify its rounded silvery grey and taupe plumage, charcoal wing and tail tips, very fluffy head tuft and cheeks, small dusky wine-red bumpy comb, tiny dark beak, and feather-covered feet. Keep it recognizable, cute and grounded like the photographed bird, not a generic white chicken.
Art: true coarse low-resolution 48x48-style pixel sprites enlarged with nearest-neighbor-looking crisp square blocks. Limited palette, 1 logical pixel dark outline, 2-3 clustered shades for feathers. No photographic feather strands, no smooth illustration, no antialiasing, no text.
Sheet: exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows, twelve isolated frames on a genuinely transparent background. Aim for 1536x1152 canvas, identical square cells, generous fully transparent gutters. Each bird occupies about 30-34 logical pixels wide and 33-37 logical pixels tall inside a 48x48 logical cell. Clear empty space on all four edges of every cell, at least 4 logical pixels of safety. Full body visible in each frame.
All frames show the SAME chicken at the SAME scale, facing to the RIGHT in a slight three-quarter view consistent with the game map. Keep the torso and feet anchored at the same floor position within each cell. No baked ground shadow, grass, props, motion lines, particles, backgrounds or grid lines.
Row 1, IDLE, 4 consecutive loop frames: calm alert pose with subtle breath; tuft lifts slightly and eye closes for a blink; tuft settles with eye reopening; neutral pose matching the first. Small meaningful changes.
Row 2, WALK, 4 consecutive loop frames IN PLACE: near foot steps forward, passing feet/body rises by only 1 logical pixel, far foot steps forward, passing feet. Alternate left and right feet clearly; gentle opposite head bob; do not translate the chicken across the cell. Maintain body dimensions.
Row 3, PECK, 4 consecutive frames: stand with head alert; lean neck/head halfway toward the ground, body remains same size; beak touches ground in front of feet, tail gently up; raise head halfway again. Bend the head and neck, not the entire image. All frames keep chicken feet on one common baseline.
Layout reading order strictly four idle frames in row one, four walk frames in row two, four peck frames in row three. Only these 12 full-body chicken drawings, no extra objects. Preserve identity and coarse pixel blocks in every frame.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent animated chicken sprite sheet for Bitácora Amorcito.
Input images: images 1 and 2 are two photos of the SAME bird, and are the identity references. Image 3 is the already accepted grey chicken animation sheet, ONLY to match pixel art style, viewpoint, size, spacing and row layout. Do not copy its grey feathers onto this bird.
Generate one sheet of the photographed BLACK crested chicken: round near-black body with a few charcoal/lavender shading clusters; an unmistakable broad floppy BLACK AND IVORY head crest spreading sideways like a feather hairstyle; long ivory cream feather streaks down the back of the head and nape; modest red facial comb and red hanging wattles; small grey beak; prominent short fan of upright dark tail feathers; bare pale grey/pink legs and toes. The fluffy two-tone head crest is essential. Body should remain BLACK, no cream patches on the torso or wings. Reproduce the bird's friendly expressive character from both photos, simplifying feathers into pixel clusters.
Exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 full body frames, equally sized square cells, roughly 1536x1152 canvas, truly transparent background. Same size in all frames. Match the game-art look of image 3 but with LESS fine feather texture: 48x48 logical pixel-art aesthetic, chunky square pixels, small limited palette, clear 1-pixel outlines, 2-3 shades per material, no smooth gradients, no realistic strands. Each sprite occupies roughly 30-34 logical pixels wide and 33-37 tall, matching the overall size of image 3. At least 4 logical pixels completely empty on each cell edge, no clipping or overlap.
All twelve sprites face RIGHT in the same gentle three-quarter profile. Same camera, same silhouette scale, one common floor baseline. Walk is IN PLACE: no translation across the cell. Keep belly volume stable. No ground shadow, grid, text, decorations, particles, grass or scenery.
Row 1 IDLE four chronological frames: calm standing eyes open; subtle breathing and a small crest bounce; short blink and crest settles; eyes open with crest returning to start. Crest sways by only a pixel or two.
Row 2 WALK four chronological loop frames: near leg forward/far leg back; feet pass and head bobs lightly; far leg forward/near leg back; feet pass returning to start. BOTH separate grey legs always anatomically readable; alternating feet visible.
Row 3 PECK four chronological loop frames: head upright; head and neck lean halfway down; head/beak reaches ground in front of feet, crest hanging over face; lift head halfway back. Body and feet keep their size and anchor. Whole bird must remain in its cell even at maximum crest extension.
Only these 12 full-body sprite frames, in strict idle/walk/peck row order. Preserve the black torso, two-tone shaggy crest and red wattles throughout.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: reusable transparent pixel-art farm hen animation sheet for a cozy overhead 2D garden RPG, Bitácora Amorcito.
Create a NORMAL WHITE HEN, no fluffy exotic crest: small red scalloped comb on top, small red wattle, round ivory-white body with light warm beige clustered shadows, visible compact wing, a short upright feather tail, tiny dark eye, ochre-yellow beak and two ochre-yellow bare legs. Friendly animal with natural bird proportions. It must read clearly as a female farm chicken rather than a duck, chick or rooster. No accessories.
Exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, TWELVE sequential frames, identical square cells on a real transparent background. Suggested canvas1536x1152. Large consistent gutters, all drawings separated and fully inside cells. Cell resembles a 48x48 game sprite; bird occupies about 30-34 logical pixels across and 33-36 tall, with at least 4 pixels clear on every edge. Draw crisp chunky pixel-art squares and stepped edges, like a low resolution 48x48 sprite enlarged without interpolation. Limited palette, dark warm-charcoal 1-logical-pixel outline, three feather shades maximum. No smooth vector curves, no photographic or painterly textures, no fine strands, no antialiasing.
Bird faces RIGHT in a gentle three-quarter side view in ALL 12 frames. Static camera, same hen, same scale and belly volume. All feet planted at a common baseline, centered at same ground anchor; walking takes place IN PLACE, so game engine can move the sprite.
Row 1: 4 IDLE loop frames, upright alert, very small breathing motion, brief eye blink, return to alert. Wing and tail remain stable.
Row 2: 4 WALK loop frames, near leg reaching forward, passing feet and small head bob, far leg reaching forward, passing feet again. Clearly alternate two separate legs. Torso moves at most one logical pixel up/down and does not resize.
Row 3: 4 PECK loop frames, alert upright head, head lowering halfway, beak touches ground immediately ahead of feet with neck bent and tail slightly lifted, head raises toward starting position. Only head/neck tilt; no whole-sprite rotation or resizing. Feet stay at floor level. Keep the beak and every tail feather in the cell.
No grass, ground, cast shadows, gridlines, labels, lettering, particles, eggs or other assets: twelve full-body hens only. Transparent gutters and crisp readable anatomy are essential for animation.

Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: BROWN farm hen variant of the provided transparent animation sheet, for Bitácora Amorcito.
Edit target: the image is the accepted WHITE HEN sprite sheet. Make a sibling BROWN HEN sheet by changing ONLY the feather colors to warm cinnamon/chestnut brown, with ochre/tan highlights and deep chocolate shadow clusters. Wing may be a slightly deeper brown, tail deep chocolate brown. Keep red comb and wattle, ochre beak and yellow legs, tiny black eyes. This is a normal hen with no exotic head crest.
Preserve the exact pixel style, dark outlines, ALL TWELVE poses, the scale of the body, the same four-column three-row layout, every frame's location and transparent gutters from the provided sheet. Do not add details or remodel the hen. Palette swap should cover the entire plumage, with no leftover large ivory patches on the breast.
Row1 four IDLE poses including blink, row2 four WALK in-place poses alternating legs, row3 four PECK poses lowering beak toward floor and returning. Keep original motion and feet anchor in all cells. Keep all drawings inside cells and keep the transparent background real alpha. No ground shadows, added props, eggs, scenery, texture, text, grid or labels.
Crisp chunky low-resolution pixel art with stepped square pixels; no smooth painterly rendering, no new feather strands. This sprite must look like the SAME production asset family as the input hen, simply in a different natural feather color.

Image 2 is ONLY the style and animation layout reference, a previously accepted grey fluffy chicken sprite sheet. Do not copy the grey plumage.
Primary request: faithfully simplify the photographed white mother hen: rounded very fluffy WHITE and IVORY body, short soft white head crest, creamy chest, white plumed upright tail, feather-covered feet with tiny grey toes, subtle small rosy-red facial comb and wattles, little grey beak, tiny dark eye with a calm protective expression. The body is white, with warm ivory and pale silver grey pixel-cluster shading; only small dark grey beak/eye/toe details. She is NOT the smooth ordinary white farm hen; she has silky fluffy feathers and feathered feet.
Art: same game-compatible pixel-art style as image 2. Coarse stepped square pixel clusters resembling an enlarged 48x48 logical game sprite, small warm palette, crisp dark outlines, two or three feather shade clusters, no smooth digital painting, no photographic feather strands.
Exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows, twelve full body consecutive animation frames, same cell dimensions as image 2 and generous fully transparent gutters. Full body in every cell, same hen size and volume. At least four logical pixels of clear margin on all cell edges. All frames face RIGHT in the same gentle three-quarter side view. One common floor baseline; walking is IN PLACE, no translation across the cell.
Row 1 IDLE, 4 frames: stand calm with eyes open; small breathing rise and crest sway; brief blink; return to relaxed open-eye pose.
Row 2 WALK, 4 frames: near feather-covered foot forward; passing feet/head rises just a little; far foot forward; passing feet returning toward start. Clearly alternating feet under the fluffy belly.
Row 3 PECK, 4 frames: upright head; head lowers halfway; beak reaches the floor immediately in front of feet, tail slightly lifts; head rises again toward the alert pose. Body does not rotate as a whole or change scale. Legs and feet stay aligned.
Background must be genuinely transparent. No chicks in THIS sheet, no ground, cast shadows, grass, eggs, labels, grid lines, particles or text. Preserve the mother's distinctive fluffy white silhouette across all twelve frames.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: BLACK BABY CHICK animation sheet for Bitácora Amorcito, accompanying the white fluffy mother in the reference.
Input images: image 1 is the identity reference. The mother hen is white; her babies on the floor are BLACK AND SILVER GREY. Create ONLY ONE baby chick repeated in animation frames. Image 2 is the accepted white mother sprite sheet, a style reference only.
Subject: a tiny round black baby chick from the photograph, with fluffy charcoal-black head and back, a small silver grey patch on the folded wing, soft pale grey lower belly/tail underside, tiny dark grey pointed beak, tiny black eye with a readable small light highlight, short grey/pink legs and toes. Baby proportions: round head, plump little body, stubby short tail, no adult comb, no red wattle, no long rooster tail, no feather-covered adult feet. The plumage must be predominantly BLACK, with a few soft grey areas; no yellow chick and no yellow beak/legs.
Create exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows, twelve isolated full-body frames. Same style family, orientation and layout as image 2, but deliberately very simple chunky low-resolution pixel art like a 24x24 character drawn with a limited palette and clear stepped square blocks. Very few feather clusters, 1-pixel charcoal outline. This is a small background game sprite, not a detailed illustration. All frames face RIGHT in a gentle three-quarter side view.
Canvas approximately 1536x1152, equally sized square cells on genuinely TRANSPARENT background, wide empty gutters and no clipped drawings. Draw each chick about 22-25 logical pixels tall inside a 48x48 logical cell so it is visibly smaller than the mother's sprite. Maintain the SAME chick scale and belly dimensions in all twelve frames. One shared floor line per row, and one shared anchor in each cell. At least 6 logical pixels clear space on all cell edges.
Row 1, IDLE four consecutive loop frames: calm open eye; small breathing puff; short blink; reopen eye, body returns to start.
Row 2, WALK four consecutive loop frames in place: near leg forward; feet passing with a slight head bob; far leg forward; feet passing back toward start. The two tiny legs alternate naturally. Baby does not travel across its cell.
Row 3, PECK four consecutive loop frames: upright; head leaning halfway down; tiny beak at ground in front of feet; head lifting back toward start. Bend head and neck only, body stays the same size. Tiny wing and tail can twitch by one pixel.
Only these 12 black chick sprites. No mother, extra chicks in one cell, ground, grass, cast shadows, motion marks, particles, text, borders or grid. Preserve clean alpha with crisp feather colors and no colored red/yellow edge halos.
